text:
Do not trust the time of eternity,

for the clouds pull at the garments,

for the winds drag me against my desire!

Hurry, love, for tomorrow I die and do not see you!

Do not delay so far away, in so secret a place,

nacre of silence that the sea compresses,

oh lip, limit of the absolute instant!

Hurry, love, for tomorrow I die,

for tomorrow I die, and do not hear you!

Appear to me now,

while I still recognize the open anemone on your face,

and around the walls,

the enemy wind...

Hurry, love, for tomorrow I die,

for tomorrow I die and do not tell you...

translation.title: Song
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the repeated urgency of love before death, sight, hearing, and speech vanish.
